detail.longDescription: I was looking around how saas based apps check their time stamps as i was curious about the whole sync they have to do across the stack , but to my surprise they do it by hand manually there was no tool for this so i thought about making one in rust. it would be helpful to get some tester for it and yess i used claude code with it , i think its faster to write code when you have a full picture of what you are making , so it would be real helpfull if you can test it so far only i tested it on few saas products repos and found some real bugs.
